北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天不闷热，但 31℃ 仍需注意防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and 31℃. Stay hydrated and protect yourself from the sun!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 32℃，风力 4级。天气闷热，小心吹风感冒哦。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 32℃ with 4-level wind. Muggy and windy, watch out for colds.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 晴天 32℃，体感 34℃。阳光猛烈，记得防晒多喝水！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 32℃, feels like 34℃. Strong sun, hydrate and use sunscreen!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 30℃，体感 33℃。湿度高体感闷热，注意防暑哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 30℃, feels like 33℃. High humidity makes it muggy, stay cool.
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 27℃，湿度 89%。湿度大易出汗，注意保持清爽。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 27℃, 89% humidity. Stay cool and dry from the high humidity.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 33℃，体感 35℃。今日高温炎热，防晒补水是关键！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 33℃, feels like 35℃. It's scorching hot, hydrate and use sunscreen!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 33℃，体感 34℃。气温较高，户外活动注意防暑。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 33℃, feels like 34℃. It's hot, take precautions against heatstroke outdoors.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨 22℃，湿度 100%。雨天路滑，记得带伞添衣哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Light rain 22℃, 100% humidity. Roads are slick, bring an umbrella and dress warmly!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 中雨 28℃，体感 30℃。雨势较大，出行请务必带伞！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain 28℃, feels like 30℃. Heavy rain, remember your umbrella!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 29℃，体感 31℃。天气稍热，注意多喝水解暑。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 29℃, feels like 31℃. It's a bit warm, drink plenty of water to cool down.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 38℃，体感 39℃！酷热难耐，务必防暑降温！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 38℃, feels like 39℃! Extremely hot, take strict heat precautions!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 28℃，体感 30℃。天气温暖，注意防晒补水哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 28℃, feels like 30℃. It's warm, remember sunscreen and hydration!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 28℃，体感 30℃。湿度稍高，保持清爽很重要。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 28℃, feels like 30℃. High humidity, staying fresh is important.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 23℃，风力 4级。微凉有风，记得带件外套哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 23℃ with 4-level wind. A bit cool and windy, bring a jacket.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 31℃，风力 4级。天气炎热，注意防晒并多喝水。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 31℃ with 4-level wind. Hot weather, remember sunscreen and hydrate.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 31℃，风力 4级。风力不小，外出注意防晒保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 31℃ with 4-level wind. Quite windy, mind sun protection and warmth.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 27℃，体感 30℃。湿度稍高，外出注意防晒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 27℃, feels like 30℃. A bit humid, remember sunscreen when out.

漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 31℃ with 5-level wind. Strong wind, remember sunscreen and hydration.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 32℃，风力 4级，小心吹风感冒，记得多补水。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 32℃ with 4-level wind. Stay hydrated and mind the wind.
